text_block_list.text:
Holding the Takarazuka Kinen was deemed nearly impossible—
and that somber mood lingered in the public as well.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It's okay, Big Brother.
Rice will be fine.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It's okay, Big Sister.
Rice will be fine.

...Even so, her smile lacks energy.
Could it be that incident after all—
(*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry, Big Brother!
Rice has to go now!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry, Big Sister!
Rice has to go now!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Just up ahead!!
Where did Rice Shower go...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ...Was that Rice-san who just ran upstairs?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: "I-I think so. She seemed really distressed, didn't she? D-Don't tell me—"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...H-Hey, stop it!
She's always been trying so hard, so why—

I rush up the stairs. Praying with all my might
that this bad feeling is nothing more than groundless worry...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Please... I'm begging you on this one!!
When I plunged toward the direction of her voice—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Keep calm! Things like this need to be addressed step by step first...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rice asked the Hanshin staff! And the Kyoto staff too!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So—please, let the Takarazuka Kinen take place!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Astonishing!?
Trainer <username> is coming too!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fueh!? Dear brother...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fueh!? Dear sister...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Rice came to ask...
the Chairwoman for a favor."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...They're asking if the 'Takarazuka Kinen'
could be held at Kyoto Racecourse..."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Repeatedly! Not only today,
but didn't you just come by last night as well?!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Every sector—! There are things we must do! Stay calm and focus on coordinating first—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I understand! That's why Rice
contacted both the Hanshin and Kyoto folks!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I know it might be a nuisance, and it might be tough,
but please, I'm begging you to help me!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of everyone who supports me,
I kept begging over and over, saying I'd do anything
and everything that I possibly could...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Ngh!? Everyone, I said calm down—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you for waiting!
The approval has finally come through!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Tazuna!! Long-awaited...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It has been decided that this year's
Takarazuka Kinen will be held at Kyoto Racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Well then!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It was made possible because the staff at both
Hanshin and Kyoto stayed in close communication.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
—The staff on both sides said
they would gladly do everything they could.
...For Rice Shower's sake, too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... I'm so glad...!
That we could... hold the event...!
choice_data_list: We've got to do our best for everyone's sake too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Mm... yeah...!
For the sake of everyone who worked so hard to make this happen, too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of everyone
who cheers Rice on...!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice is going to run in the Takarazuka Kinen...!
Because... Rice wants to make everyone smile...!
